name: Forest greens
summary: Forest vegetables beside the grill and in the salad. Báo Sơn La, on 16 July 2026, dips them in wet chẩm chéo with sticky rice, grilled meat, stream fish, and boiled chicken. On 4 September 2020 the same paper builds nộm from forest greens, ban flower, and banana flower, with peanuts, cilantro, sawtooth cilantro, and mắc khén. A single recipe was not printed.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 16 July 2026 and 4 September 2020. Cổng thông tin xã Hua La and Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam also name forest greens at Bản Mòng.
howToEat: Beside the fish, or as the salad. An hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Bản Mòng and the Thái table. A market bunch was not given a stall name.
